The frozen architecture requires runtime journal authority, projection-only AgentSession/Process, no fabricated terminal sequence, DB fail-closed and OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; it also names the absent services/task_readback_metadata.py path.

Celery-derived snapshots are mapped to mutable AgentTask terminal states and task.completed/task.failed events, then aggregated into session status.
The process projection merges Celery active/scheduled/reserved observations with DB running jobs and labels both as active tasks.
Heterogeneous provider/control states are collapsed to running, completed or failed.
The fixture explicitly expects AsyncResult SUCCESS/FAILURE to produce completed/failed AgentSession tasks and projected terminal events.
